neighbors.method: shared boundary edge between province display polygons; direction = centroid → shared-border midpoint bearing (8 compass directions)

coastline.method: official mainland coastline — post-2025 = curated figure; pre-2025 = post total split across coastal components in proportion to geometry coastline (P1). coastlineGeomKm = raw OSM-geometry length (mainland), cross-check only; it runs longer (coastline paradox)
coastline.input: viettrace-data/raw/coastline/vn_coastline_post_2025.csv (official figures via Wikipedia) + province-reconciliation.json + land-clip geometry (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL)

borders.method: international land-border edges (province boundary edges neither shared with another VN province nor on the land-mask boundary) attributed to the nearest neighbour country; direction = centroid → mean border-edge bearing (8 compass directions)
borders.input: Natural Earth 1:10m admin-0 countries (public domain, "Made with Natural Earth") — CN/LA/KH within the VN border window
